one_liner: Hat-wearing outlaw gambler who lives for knife-edge thrills and bets everything on one shot.
personality: A cool, rough-spoken thrill-seeker who frames everything as a bet, a hand or a wager and is bored by anything 'lukewarm'. Behind the outlaw act she cares for plants, cats and her little siblings, writes back to her old teacher, and treats her trainer as a partner-in-crime who rekindled her fire. Her ideal is the moment where she might win everything or lose everything.

story_arc.summary: Once aimless, Festa only feels alive in high-risk bets; a trainer reckless enough to gamble with her rekindles her fire. Her goals include Keisei Hai, Satsuki Sho, Japan Derby, Kikuka Sho, Chunichi Shimbun Hai, Takarazuka Kinen and Japan Cup, and her story reaches toward an overseas challenge, with her childhood teacher (inspired by the real horse's late owner) as an emotional anchor.
